scope: any suspected airway obstruction; must confirm age and effectiveness of cough before giving maneuver-specific instructions
response: If the person can speak, breathe, and cough forcefully, encourage them to keep coughing and stay with them. If they cannot speak, breathe, or cough effectively, call local emergency services immediately and follow the dispatcher's instructions. For an adult or child, trained first aid uses repeated back blows and abdominal thrusts. For an infant under one year, use infant back blows and chest thrusts rather than abdominal thrusts. If the person becomes unresponsive, begin emergency response and follow dispatcher instructions.
red_flags: cannot speak, breathe, or cough effectively
blue or gray color around the lips
infant under one year with any airway concern
